nom: QUIA Collagen Overnight Wrapping Mask - Firmer

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with rosacea found the peel-off step drying and irritating, while another whose skin is usually sensitive to new products reported no negative reaction at all over weeks of use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their mid-40s to late 40s report firmer, smoother, brighter skin the morning after use, including one with decades of acne scarring who saw scars visibly fade after just two applications.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers in their mid-40s to late 40s report firmer, smoother, brighter, more youthful-looking skin the morning after use; one reviewer, however, saw no real change in wrinkles around her eyes or forehead after five days of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe waking up with noticeably more hydrated, plump, and soft skin after an overnight application; one reviewer with rosacea, however, found that peeling the mask off felt like it took a layer of skin with it and left her face dry enough to need a heavy moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers who received a batch that smelled like glue reported their skin turned red, dry, and inflamed after use or removal.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with a lifelong history of cystic and hormonal acne reported a major reduction in her acne scarring and dark spots after just two uses.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer's chin broke out after her first use, while another with skin that's usually sensitive to new products reported no breakouts at all over several weeks of use.

aspects.libelle: Bottle or tube arrives only half full
Smells and applies like glue while wet
Peels off in one satisfying piece
Only yields a few uses per bottle for the price
Leaves a tight, shiny, glowy finish once dry

extraits.titre: The same product but different formulas.
extraits.texte: The first bottle I bought was great. No smell. Peeled off easily. The second bottle with the gold band was horrible. It smelled like glue. It hurt peeling it off. My skin was red and dry. It peeled off in pieces and I had to go at it with my fingernails. I won't buy this again from this seller. I just bought it because Amazon is fast.

extraits.titre: Not really what's advertisedNot really what's advertised
extraits.texte: The bottle is small, not full. However, day 1: scrubbed My face added my night cream and then applied this mask. Within a few minutes, my face hardened. I was talking but, my lips and face was stiff as a board! "Maybe I put to much gel on"? Doesn't really specify amount. Woke up: peel off wasn't hard. It did come off in sections. So I used a warm wash cloth to finish cleaning my face. I noticed my chin broke out. Day 5: my skin does have a glow about it. However, no real wrinkle change around the eyes or forehead. I will continue to use until bottle is gone. Im 43, don't wear make up. And my skin is usually clear. Pics: day1, 3, 5

extraits.titre: Good but dries skin a bit
extraits.texte: My face looks decently good after I use it but when I peel it does feel like im taking an entire layer off with it. I usually use a moisture mask or heavy cream after because my face feels a bit dry. I wouldn't buy it again probably. I blame my rosacea.

This product is amazing on two main levels. 1. I’ve had bad cystic and hormonal acne most of my life (I’m 49 years old now). All that acne left a lot of scarring and dark spots on my face, mostly from the chin up the side of my face - on both sides. I’ve used this mask TWICE and already see a major difference in my skin. Acne scarring is slowly going away. I’ve never found a product that does as good of a job as this mask did after two uses. 2. Peeling off this mask is SO SATISFYING. If you ever put Elmer’s glue all over your hand, let it dry, and peeled it off like you were a snake, this mask is for you. You apply it, let it dry, sleep with in, but the next morning, it peels off so beautifully - this mask works but is also FUN 😆 For me and my skin issues, it totally worked. Great purchase - 10/10

extraits.titre: Best skin care mask I have ever used
extraits.texte: This is the best moisturizing collagen mask I’ve ever had in my life! I wash my face at night and put a medium to thin layer all over my face. I let it set for 15 minutes and then I go to sleep. In the morning, I wake up and my mask feels tight, and it comes off in one piece, almost like the shedding of a snake skin! All day my skin is glowing. It feels hydrated and soft. I will forever be using this mask, I have used it for a few weeks now. My skin is usually sensitive to any change in my routine, but this did nothing but positive things for my skin. No breakouts. The picture that I am attaching is the mask that came off this morning.

Absolutely love this mask! Im 46 and when I wake up my skin is noticeably smoother, firmer, and super-glowy. Its really easy to peel off (I actually enjoy peeling it) it didn’t irritate my skin at all. My face looked refreshed, hydrated, and plump in the morning. Definitely part of my overnight skin care routine. 💖

extraits.titre: Middle aged lady review. Sorry if my eyes looked crazy.  Felt good.
extraits.texte: Love this mask. Easy to apply and my face feels really firm after. Easy on the skin. Feels firmer and brighter. Pic is 20 minutes after I applied before bed. For reference age 48.
